_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::thermal#0. Four runs of one 3-hex8 transient (OneStepTheta) PROBLEMTYPE: Thermo bar, in two pairs that differ in exactly one word. 'DESIGN SURF DIRICH CONDITIONS' holding the ends at 0/100 gives node 5 = 6.33050962998814626e+01; renaming that section to 'DESIGN SURF THERMO DIRICH CONDITIONS' gives EXACTLY 0.00000000000000000e+00 and exit 0 on a deck without a result test. Same for NEUMANN: plain gives 1.08603291977074412e+00, THERMO-prefixed gives exactly zero. Neither prefixed run emits any diagnostic — PREF_SECTION_NAME_REJECTED=0, PREF_DROP_DIAGNOSTIC=0 — and both still reach the result test, so the section parsed and was then discarded. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
